page.overview:
Who is Doug Durbrow?

Lieutenant commander Doug Durbrow was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century. His serial number was FSN 580-22-8563.

In 2364, he was a crewmember aboard the . On or about stardate 41044.2, according to an order sent by Commodore Bill Marafe of Starbase 55, he was scheduled for a transfer to the . (, okudagram)
